analyseCodemixedCall.description: Reads a code-mixed Indian support utterance (Hinglish, Tanglish, Benglish, etc.), tags each word's language, finds intra-sentential switch points, resolves one intent, and drafts an English ticket. Use this before replying to a caller who mixes languages mid-sentence.

utterance.description: The caller's raw transcript, in whatever language mix they used.

intent.description: Resolved single intent, e.g. 'Order not delivered, tracking stale'.

languages.description: Languages detected in the utterance, e.g. ['Hindi','English'].

switch_points.description: Number of intra-sentential language switch boundaries.

order_id.description: 5-digit order reference extracted from the utterance, if present.

reply_mixed.description: Suggested reply in the caller's own language mix.
